instruction: Set up Apache mod_rewrite rules
output:
a2enmod rewrite && cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/rewrite.conf << 'EOF'
<VirtualHost *:80>
  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteRule ^/old-page$ /new-page [R=301,L]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
  RewriteRule ^ index.php [L]
</VirtualHost>
EOF && a2ensite rewrite.conf && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Secure Apache with SSL
output:
a2enmod ssl && openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout /etc/ssl/private/apache-selfsigned.key -out /etc/ssl/certs/apache-selfsigned.crt -subj '/CN=localhost' && cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/default-ssl.conf << 'EOF'
<IfModule mod_ssl.c>
  <VirtualHost _default_:443>
    ServerAdmin admin@example.com
    DocumentRoot /var/www/html
    SSLEngine on
    SSLCertificateFile /etc/ssl/certs/apache-selfsigned.crt
    SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/ssl/private/apache-selfsigned.key
  </VirtualHost>
</IfModule>
EOF && a2ensite default-ssl && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Enable HTTP/2 in Apache
output: a2enmod http2 && echo -e '<VirtualHost *:443>\n  Protocols h2 http/1.1\n</VirtualHost>' >> /etc/apache2/sites-available/default-ssl.conf && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Configure Apache reverse proxy
output:
a2enmod proxy proxy_http && cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/reverse-proxy.conf << 'EOF'
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ProxyPass /app http://localhost:3000/
  ProxyPassReverse /app http://localhost:3000/
</VirtualHost>
EOF && a2ensite reverse-proxy && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set up HAProxy with health checks and SSL termination
output:
cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg << 'EOF'
global
  maxconn 4096
defaults
  mode http
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 30s
  timeout server 30s
frontend https-in
  bind *:443 ssl crt /etc/ssl/certs/haproxy.pem
  default_backend webservers
backend webservers
  balance roundrobin
  option httpchk GET /health
  server web1 192.168.1.10:80 check inter 3s
  server web2 192.168.1.11:80 check inter 3s
EOF && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Set up HAProxy maintenance page
output:
echo '

Under Maintenance

' > /var/www/maintenance.html && cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg << 'EOF' frontend http-in bind *:80 acl maintenance hdr_dom(host) -i maintenance.example.com use_backend maintenance if maintenance default_backend webservers backend maintenance server local 127.0.0.1:8080 check EOF && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Set up HAProxy rate limiting
output:
cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg << 'EOF'
frontend http-in
  bind *:80
  stick-table type ip size 100k expire 30s store http_req_rate(10s)
  http-request track-sc0 src
  http-request deny deny_status 429 if { sc_http_req_rate(0) gt 100 }
  default_backend webservers
EOF
